caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, cylindrical pottery vessel positioned centrally within a plain rectangular border. The vessel features an earthy brown color that gradually transitions into a lighter beige towards the base, with darker speckled spots distributed over its surface. The neck is slightly narrower than the body, decorated with a horizontal zigzag line and additional horizontal bands. A curved handle is attached at the top right side near the neck, rendered in a similar color but with lighter shading. The upper rim of the vessel is outlined with a dashed line, possibly suggesting an incomplete or broken portion, and the entire vessel is shown from a slightly angled viewpoint. In the bottom right corner of the border, the name "Annie B. Johnston" is written in small script. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Stoneware Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
